response_terms.z_x: p_D * grad R_rob standardized on calibration fold

subtitle: A Predeclared Falsification Protocol for MAAT v1.7 Gate-Aware Structural Selection

success_criteria.failure: Gate fails if it does not beat score_with_R in at least 2 primary domains, or if improvements vanish under shuffled/null controls, or if gains require post-hoc threshold tuning.
success_criteria.minimum_support: Gate beats score_with_R in at least 2 of 3 primary external domains with paired bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0, and no primary domain shows a CI upper bound < 0 against score_with_R.
success_criteria.strong_support: Gate beats both score_with_R and the strongest classical baseline in all 3 primary external domains with paired bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0.
success_criteria.v2_claim_rule: No v2.0 claim is allowed unless strong_support is met on external benchmarks.
